create.heading: Create a gig
create.permissionDenied: Only signed-in venue accounts can publish gigs.
create.unconfigured: Event publishing is unavailable until the platform API is configured.
create.setupBody: Save your venue's address and map location before publishing. This is the venue location, not your phone's current location.
create.coordinatesHelp: Check the coordinates match your venue. You can enter coordinates from a map manually, including on web.
create.locationPermission: Android requires location permission for address lookup. You can enter the venue coordinates manually instead.
create.locationNotUnique: The address did not resolve to one location. Use a more specific address or enter the venue coordinates manually.
create.locationFailed: Could not look up the address. Enter the venue coordinates manually.
create.saveVenueFailed: Could not save venue details. Your entries have been kept.
create.timeHelp: Use YYYY-MM-DD dates and 24-hour HH:mm times. Times use the venue timezone above, not your phone timezone. Overnight shows need the following day's end date.
create.publishHelp: A photo is required. Your gig stays private while its image uploads and is checked. It becomes public only when publication is confirmed.
create.publishFailed: Could not publish the event. Your entries have been kept.
create.successBody: Your gig is public and will appear in your upcoming venue events. Nearby recommendations depend on the viewer's location.

validation.title: Enter a gig title.
validation.dateTime: Enter a real date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a 24-hour time (HH:mm).
validation.timeZone: Enter a valid venue timezone, such as Europe/London.
validation.ticketUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS ticket or booking link.
validation.endTime: The end date and time must be after the start.
validation.endPair: Enter both an end date and end time, or leave both empty.
validation.form: Check the title, dates, description and booking link.
validation.venue: Enter a venue name, full address and valid latitude (-90 to 90) and longitude (-180 to 180).

poster.imageRequired: Choose a photo or poster before publishing your gig.
poster.unavailable: Image uploads are unavailable. You cannot publish without a photo. Try again shortly.
poster.privatePreparation: This gig is not published. Complete its details and photo to post it.
poster.needsImage: Not published — complete the gig and its photo.
poster.otherPreparation: Another gig has a saved preparation. Open Create gig without selecting a different gig to finish that attempt first.
poster.replacementHelp: A published gig must keep its photo. The current image stays public until its replacement is ready.
poster.limits: One still JPEG, PNG or WebP image, up to 10 MiB and 25 megapixels. The whole poster is kept without cropping.
poster.previewFailed: This poster could not be displayed. Choose another image or try again.
poster.unsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. Export HEIC, SVG or other formats first.
poster.animated: Animated posters are not supported. Choose a still image.
poster.tooLarge: The poster is too large. Choose an image no larger than 10 MiB.
poster.tooManyPixels: Choose a poster no larger than 25 megapixels.
poster.unreadable: The selected image could not be read. Choose another poster.
poster.pickerFailed: Could not open or read your photos. Check photo permissions in Settings and try again.
poster.uploadFailed: Image publication could not be confirmed. Check the gig's current state before retrying; this will not create another gig.
poster.reselectAfterRestart: Choose the photo again to complete this private preparation. Local selections are not saved across restarts.
poster.pendingBody: Recover the same saved attempt before starting another gig. Your details are kept, and recovery will not create a duplicate. Choose a photo to continue.
poster.invalidRecovery: The saved publication recovery record is unreadable or uses an unsupported format.
poster.invalidRecoveryHelp: Check your venue's Home page for a possibly published gig before discarding this record. Discarding removes only local recovery information; it does not delete a published gig.
poster.discardRecoveryConfirmation: Have you checked venue Home? Forget this local recovery record? A gig may already be published. This does not delete any server gig.
poster.missingEvent: No gig was selected. Open poster management from one of your gigs.
poster.notOwner: You can only manage posters for your own venue's gigs.
poster.publicHelp: Only the processed poster is public. Your original upload stays private. This page changes the poster, not the gig details.
poster.refreshFailed: Could not check the current poster. Refresh before retrying attachment, or open poster management.
